query: UPDATE media_jobs SET state=$3,stage=$4,progress=$5,result_url=$6,result_path=$7,error=$8,error_kind=$9,attempt_token=NULL,lease_expires_at=NULL,retry_at=CASE WHEN $10 THEN now()+interval '5 seconds' ELSE now() END,finished_at=CASE WHEN $3 IN ('ready','failed') THEN now() ELSE NULL END,updated_at=now() WHERE id=$1 AND attempt_token=$2 AND state='running' AND lease_expires_at > now()
